tasks.label: Experiment: Build
args: case "${input:experiment}" in g1_real_dance_1) target=g1_real_dance_1 ;; g1_real_dance_2) target=g1_real_dance_2 ;; go2_sim_cz_m0p1) target=go2_sim_cz_m0p1 ;; go2_sim_m_p3kg) target=go2_sim_m_p3kg ;; go2_sim_m_p3kg_kappa) target=go2_sim_m_p3kg_kappa ;; go2_real_belly_plate_4p6kg) target=go2_real_belly_plate_4p6kg ;; *) echo "Unknown experiment: ${input:experiment}" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; cmake --build build --target "$target" -j2

tasks.label: Experiment: Run
args: case "${input:experiment}" in g1_real_dance_1) target=g1_real_dance_1; exe=build/experiments/G1_real_dance_1/g1_real_dance_1; cfg=experiments/G1_real_dance_1/config/g1_real_dance_1.xml ;; g1_real_dance_2) target=g1_real_dance_2; exe=build/experiments/G1_real_dance_2/g1_real_dance_2; cfg=experiments/G1_real_dance_2/config/g1_real_dance_2.xml ;; go2_sim_cz_m0p1) target=go2_sim_cz_m0p1; exe=build/experiments/Go2_sim_cz_-0.1m/go2_sim_cz_m0p1; cfg=experiments/Go2_sim_cz_-0.1m/config/Go2_sim_cz_-0.1m.xml ;; go2_sim_m_p3kg) target=go2_sim_m_p3kg; exe=build/experiments/Go2_sim_m_+3kg/go2_sim_m_p3kg; cfg=experiments/Go2_sim_m_+3kg/config/Go2_sim_m_+3kg.xml ;; go2_sim_m_p3kg_kappa) target=go2_sim_m_p3kg_kappa; exe=build/experiments/Go2_sim_m_p3kg_kappa/go2_sim_m_p3kg_kappa; cfg=experiments/Go2_sim_m_p3kg_kappa/config/Go2_sim_m_p3kg_kappa.xml ;; go2_real_belly_plate_4p6kg) target=go2_real_belly_plate_4p6kg; exe=build/experiments/Go2_real_belly_plate_4.6kg/go2_real_belly_plate_4p6kg; cfg=experiments/Go2_real_belly_plate_4.6kg/config/go2_real_belly_plate_4.6kg.xml ;; *) echo "Unknown experiment: ${input:experiment}" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; cmake --build build --target "$target" -j2 && "$exe" "$cfg"

tasks.label: Experiment: Visualize
args: case "${input:experiment}" in g1_real_dance_1) vis=experiments/G1_real_dance_1/visualizer/meshcat_g1.py; results=experiments/G1_real_dance_1/results ;; g1_real_dance_2) vis=experiments/G1_real_dance_2/visualizer/meshcat_g1.py; results=experiments/G1_real_dance_2/results ;; go2_sim_cz_m0p1) vis=experiments/Go2_sim_cz_-0.1m/visualizer/meshcat_go2.py; results=experiments/Go2_sim_cz_-0.1m/results ;; go2_sim_m_p3kg) vis=experiments/Go2_sim_m_+3kg/visualizer/meshcat_go2.py; results=experiments/Go2_sim_m_+3kg/results ;; go2_sim_m_p3kg_kappa) vis=experiments/Go2_sim_m_p3kg_kappa/visualizer/meshcat_go2.py; results=experiments/Go2_sim_m_p3kg_kappa/results ;; go2_real_belly_plate_4p6kg) vis=experiments/Go2_real_belly_plate_4.6kg/visualizer/meshcat_go2.py; results=experiments/Go2_real_belly_plate_4.6kg/results ;; *) echo "Unknown experiment: ${input:experiment}" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; python3 "$vis" "$results"
